{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check that flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g have no missing values
print(f"Missing in flipper_length_mm: {df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()}")
print(f"Missing in body_mass_g: {df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()}")

# Compute the Pearson correlation
correlation = df['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation: {correlation}")"}
